latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: Feishu/Lark bot to Clawdbot bridge via WebSocket

raw_record.summary: Connect a Feishu (Lark) bot to Clawdbot via WebSocket long-connection. No public server, domain, or ngrok required. Use when setting up Feishu/Lark as a messaging channel, troubleshooting the Feishu bridge, or managing the bridge service (start/stop/logs). Covers bot creation on Feishu Open Platform, credential setup, bridge startup, macOS launchd auto-restart, and group chat behavior tuning.
